data.description: The TLS certificate of a domain expires in 14 days or less, or the panel could not get one.
data.subject: Check the certificate of {{domain}}
data.body:
Hello {{name}},

The panel could not renew the TLS certificate of {{domain}} (website {{website}}).

Expiry: {{expiresAt}} ({{days}} days)

The panel renews a certificate 30 days before it expires. When the certificate expires, browsers show a warning for the website.

Make sure that the DNS record of {{domain}} points to the server of the website. Then open the domains of the website in the panel and select "Check DNS":
{{panelUrl}}
data.originalBody:
Hello {{name}},

The panel could not renew the TLS certificate of {{domain}} (website {{website}}).

Expiry: {{expiresAt}} ({{days}} days)

The panel renews a certificate 30 days before it expires. When the certificate expires, browsers show a warning for the website.

Make sure that the DNS record of {{domain}} points to the server of the website. Then open the domains of the website in the panel and select "Check DNS":
{{panelUrl}}
